title: Lab Rat SMP
description: Survival server with a 3-Life System. Random elements will be occasionally introduced.
body:
Lab Rat SMP is a survival server built around a three-life system.


Every death counts. Once your lives run out, your only chance is other players.


Revival is possible through cooperation, which naturally leads to friendships, rivalries, deals, betrayals, and all the usual SMP chaos.


The server is designed to stay casual while giving player interactions real meaning. Expect normal SMP gameplay with a few twists introduced over time.

(For any casual players worried that this may be too high-stakes, don't worry, revival isn't too expensive.)


**JOINING THE DISCORD IS REQUIRED TO BE WHITELISTED**
